description_en: Modifies the basic information of a specified gateway cluster, such as its name and description
description_zh: 对指定网关集群的基本信息进行修改，包括网关集群名称、描述
kebab_example: aliyun sgw modify-storage-bundle --storage-bundle-id sb-000ibk4xrlr03qrjr000 --name alex-123000 --description For_testing --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyStorageBundle

parameters.description_en: The ID of the gateway cluster.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the gateway cluster
parameters.name: storage_bundle_id

parameters.description_en: The name of the gateway cluster. The name must be 1 to 60 characters in length. It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character.
parameters.description_zh: 网关集群名。长度限制1~60个字符，可以包含大小写字母，中文，数字，“.”，“_”或“-”，同时必须以大小写字母或者中文开头。
